help.sum:
We offer the following delivery options for orders placed before 2pm Monday-Friday (please note during periods of high volume this may differ). We'll provide an estimated delivery date at checkout based on your delivery selection:
DPD Express Delivery
£7.99
1-2 working days
Royal Mail Tracked 48
£4.99
4-6 working days
Royal Mail Tracked 24
Isle of Man, Jersey & Guernsey
5-7 working days
For full delivery information, please visit our Help Centre (click here).
Our packaging is branded with the Pretty Green logo and we do not currently offer gift packaging/wrapping.
Delivery dates given at checkout are estimates only, not guaranteed.
Due to the UK public holiday our fulfilment centre will be closed on 25/05/2026. All express orders placed over this period will be despatched with priority on 26/05/2026 when we return.
Order Amendment/cancellation: Unfortunately, once payment has been accepted, we cannot amend your order in the following ways: changing the size or colour of an item, removing an item, adding an item, or changing payment method.

Refund policy
UK Returns: We hope you are delighted with your purchase, however we will accept returns within 30 days of the receipt of your order, should you wish for an exchange or refund. Please ensure the item(s) are in their original condition and packaging, with all tags attached. Please include your return form paperwork in the return parcel with your return request (refund/exchange) clearly marked.
To register your return, please log on to our Returns Portal and follow the steps provided. You will need your order number as stated on your order confirmation and the email address used to place the order.
We offer an easy tracked return service in the UK. To return any orders from outside of the UK please visit our partner’s returns portal.
If you choose to return via our return service, the costs indicated below will be deducted from your refund.
Return Method
Return Courier Charge
Royal Mail

Pretty Green Help Centre: delivery, returns, orders and account questions, plus contact options for the customer service team.
UK delivery: DPD Express Delivery £7.99 (1-2 working days) or Royal Mail Tracked 48 £4.99 (4-6 working days) for orders placed before 2pm Monday-Friday.
UK returns: within 30 days of receipt via the Returns Portal; tracked Royal Mail returns cost £5.00, deducted from your refund.

about.sum:
Pretty Green captures the spirit of rock ‘n’ roll, embodying the essence of rebellion and individuality. Drawing inspiration from Britain’s rich history of subculture, from the mods to the ravers, we seamlessly combine past and present.
Founded by Liam Gallagher in 2009, Pretty Green unites those who share a passion for music and fashion. As a brand synonymous with music, we’re committed to nurturing the next generation of artists, with 2024 marking our inaugural festival sponsorship at Truck Festival in Oxford.
Autumn ’26: inspired by the nightlife of 90s Manchester and the rise of rave culture. Shot with Manchester four-piece Arkayla, one of the city’s most exciting acts.
